Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
7:53 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 go for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core Ultra 5/7 chip; everything else is secondary. Which kind of programming do you do: web and apps, or AI and games?

RAM: 16 GB is the floor if you run code editors, browsers and Docker together. Pick a laptop with a free slot so you can upgrade later.
Storage: 512 GB minimum, ideally with a spare slot.
Screen and keyboard: a 14 to 15.6 inch matte or bright 1080p screen and a keyboard you like typing on for hours. Try one in a shop if you can.
Battery: look for real-world reviews, not the claim on the box.
Graphics card: skip it unless you'll train AI or build games. It adds weight and cost you won't use.

Prices change a lot by seller and sale, so check current ones before you buy. I can shortlist 3 once you tell me your work type.
